fb_living_wage_bcd48e_01.desc: Should the federal minimum wage be increased to keep up with the cost of living? What do you think?

fb_living_wage_bcd48e_02.desc: Can someone working full-time on the federal minimum wage realistically afford housing and basic expenses? What do you think?

fb_living_wage_bcd48e_03.desc: Should the federal minimum wage automatically increase with inflation? What do you think?

fb_living_wage_bcd48e_04.desc: Would raising the minimum wage help workers more than it would hurt small businesses? What do you think?

fb_living_wage_bcd48e_05.desc: Should every state have to meet a national minimum wage floor even if local costs differ? What do you think?

fb_living_wage_bcd48e_06.desc: Would a higher minimum wage reduce the need for workers to rely on public assistance? What do you think?

fb_living_wage_bcd48e_07.desc: Should the federal minimum wage be tied to regional living costs rather than set at one national level? What do you think?

fb_living_wage_bcd48e_08.desc: Could a higher minimum wage cause some employers to reduce hiring or hours? What do you think?

fb_living_wage_bcd48e_09.desc: Should tipped workers be included in a higher federal minimum wage? What do you think?

fb_living_wage_bcd48e_10.desc: Is the current federal minimum wage enough for a full-time worker to support a family? What do you think?

fb_living_wage_bcd48e_11.desc: Would gradually increasing the minimum wage give businesses enough time to adjust? What do you think?

fb_living_wage_bcd48e_12.desc: Should Congress raise the minimum wage even if some economists warn about possible job losses? What do you think?

fb_living_wage_bcd48e_13.desc: Could higher wages increase consumer spending in local communities? What do you think?

fb_living_wage_bcd48e_14.desc: Should minimum wage increases be larger in cities where rent and transportation costs are especially high? What do you think?

fb_living_wage_bcd48e_15.desc: Would a higher minimum wage help reduce income inequality? What do you think?

fb_living_wage_bcd48e_16.desc: Should the federal government require employers to provide a living wage rather than only a legal minimum? What do you think?

fb_living_wage_bcd48e_17.desc: Could small businesses receive temporary tax credits to offset the cost of a minimum wage increase? What do you think?

fb_living_wage_bcd48e_18.desc: Should minimum wage policy focus on workers without college degrees who face high living costs? What do you think?

fb_living_wage_bcd48e_19.desc: Would automatic annual wage adjustments prevent Congress from repeatedly debating the same issue? What do you think?

fb_living_wage_bcd48e_20.desc: Is raising the minimum wage the best way to improve low-income workers' living standards, or are tax credits more effective? What do you think?
